body: Canonicalise the rare-type scoreboard: run scripts/rare_type_gold_review.py, hand-verify the ~120-row gold sample (positives + FP columns per type), feed verdicts back to upgrade the scoreboard from a proven relative round-vs-round comparator to an absolute GO/NO-GO gate (choice 0093 GO-precision is currently unvalidated).

Header-hint deletion is BLOCKED on training-data fortification (choice 0094, memory header-hint-deletion-blocked-multi-instrument). Wholesale delete/defer regressed (delete: gate NO-GO + m-19 -4pp; defer: m-19 -1.7pp). Revisit per-arm ONLY after fortification turns the model-gap families (url/datetime/isbn/postal/amount, header_hint_cross_domain) model-covered, then re-measure on all four instruments.

Re-baseline the multi-lens diagnostic on v19. Its corroborated gaps (eval/gittables/corpus_pass/report.md) were scored against v22 false positives and the rare-type-blind metric; re-run against shipped v19 + the rare-type scoreboard before treating any gap as a retrain target.

Taxonomy-gap ledger (seeded by gold-corpus adjudication 2026-06-10, choice 0095 evolution policy): four missing keys surfaced by two-panel review — DMY-slash-with-seconds timestamp, ISO timestamp without Z/offset, timezone abbreviations (EST/CEST/AKST), numeric month — plus fallback-heavy plain_text families (GCP resource paths, XML doc-refs, path slugs, neighbourhood names) that are candidate types or deliberate catch-alls, and the pruning question (types with ~zero real-corpus incidence). Evidence: gold_review_queue_v1_llm.tsv notes, skip/unsure rows, instrument_audit.md. Deliverable: a taxonomy-evolution discovery session when the author wants it — adds AND prunes argued from gold evidence per the Precision Principle.

Scoreboard + gold-lens refinement: count protocol-relative //-prefixed values as url-positive (the only 2 errors in the 195-row validated sample were //domain/... columns wrongly in the url negative pool — scoreboard_canonicalisation.md). Touches build_rare_type_gold.py URL value predicate and gold_lens_prelabel.py URL_RE. Re-run the scoreboard after to confirm the negative pools clean up.
